# Rubrol

> Fast, memory-safe PDF/A-3b & Factur-X/ZUGFeRD generation sidecar engine powered by native Typst. Replaces headless Chrome, Puppeteer, and Gotenberg with sub-10ms compilation, 95% less RAM, and zero JVM overhead.

## Overview
Rubrol is a lightweight, drop-in document generation sidecar and CLI engine. It compiles declarative Typst templates into PDF/A-3b documents with embedded EN 16931-compliant XML in under 10 milliseconds.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-10ms PDF Generation**: Native Rust/Typst engine compiles PDFs in 8.4ms vs 1,500ms+ for Puppeteer/Headless Chrome.
- **Microscopic Memory Footprint**: Uses <30MB RAM compared to 500MB–1GB required by Chromium instances.
- **European E-Invoicing Compliance**: Native ISO 19005-3 (PDF/A-3b) and EN 16931 support (Factur-X, ZUGFeRD, Chorus Pro, XRechnung) with automated /AFRelationship attachment dictionaries.
- **Drop-in HTTP Sidecar**: Run alongside your Node.js, Go, Python, or Ruby backend via Docker or serverless containers.
- **Live Interactive Studio**: Real-time browser playground with split-pane Typst editing and sub-10ms WebAssembly PDF preview.

## API Quickstart
Send a POST request to `/v1/render`:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.rubrol.com/v1/render \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "template": "= Invoice #1024\nTotal: 120.00 EUR",
    "format": "pdfa-3b"
  }'
```

Factur-X / ZUGFeRD generation via `/v1/facturx/render`:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.rubrol.com/v1/facturx/render \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "template": "= Factur-X Invoice\nAmount: 500 EUR",
    "xml": "<rsm:CrossIndustryInvoice>...</rsm:CrossIndustryInvoice>",
    "profile": "EN16931"
  }'
```
